about: The client's own copy of the guardian being created, which the creation window's guardian page edits.

evidence.says: Script Extender exposes it as ClientCCCompanionDefinition with Race, Subrace, BodyType, BodyShape, RootTemplate, Voice, VOLines, Visual
a race and a subrace chosen in the guardian page's lists appear here, in the dummy definition and in the server's CompanionDefinition; a Visual written here stays on the client
Script Extender's header Components/CharacterCreation.h binds ClientCCCompanionDefinition to this engine name; the offsets are the ones its legacy field names carry
reported from a run of character creation, not read again here: the client edits the guardian here, and no change of the window was found that sends a look written into it
